description: Expanding null after a successful argument of try makes the call fail
notes: The README says try evaluates its argument expressions in order until one produces a result without errors, so try(1, null...) would give 1, and the spec doesn't say what expanding null does (native/functions/expand-null-is-error). hashicorp/hcl rejects the null before calling the function (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so try never runs.
